summary: Protected file-position seek. Validates the file index a1 against the open-file count uNumber and checks the handle's open flag (bit 0 of the per-handle record at dword_8D4920). On success, enters the file critical section, performs the seek via FileSeekViaSetFilePointer, leaves the critical section, and returns the seek result. On failure, writes a TLS error code 9 and a TLS sub-field 0, then returns -1.

operations.description: Guard: file index a1 must be less than the open-file count uNumber (global 0x008D4A20).
Guard: the handle's open flag (bit 0) at per-handle record dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F) + 4 must be set for the seek to proceed.
Enter the file critical section for handle a1 via CriticalSectionEnterWithLazyInit.
Perform the seek: call FileSeekViaSetFilePointer(a1, lDistanceToMove, dwMoveMethod) and keep its return value.
Leave the file critical section for handle a1 via FileCriticalSectionLeave.
Return the seek result produced by FileSeekViaSetFilePointer.
Error path: store error code 9 into the TLS slot returned by TLSOffsetGetter.
Error path: store 0 into the second TLS slot returned by TLSOffsetGetter_afd8.
Return -1 to signal the failed seek on the error path.
